name: B. R. Ambedkar
summary: B. R. Ambedkar fought caste discrimination and helped shape India's constitutional democracy.

facts.text: Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee of India's Constituent Assembly.
facts.context: His legal and social reform work shows how ideas about dignity can become institutions, rights, and public duties.
facts.sourceTitle: Parliament of India: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
